build_offline_rl_agent: build a python module implementing OfflineBuilder to create an offline RL agent with make_learner and make_actor methods
build_actor_learner_agent: build a python module implementing ActorLearnerBuilder to create an online RL agent with replay tables and adders
create_builder_wrapper: create a python module using ActorLearnerBuilderWrapper to wrap an existing builder and add custom behavior
implement_make_replay_tables: implement the make_replay_tables method returning a list of reverb Table objects for experience storage
implement_make_dataset_iterator: implement the make_dataset_iterator method returning an iterator over samples from a reverb client
